title: [CON2-14] Dangling or wrong cross-references in the new text
description: Review finding CON2-14: Dangling or wrong cross-references in the new text (lens CON2). Location: spec/12-security.md:179; spec/05-messaging.md:353; ARCHITECTURE.md:265. Fix: (1) `x-agora-timestamp` appears nowhere else; §10.2.3 uses RFC 9421 `created` ("integer seconds since the Unix epoch", 10:190). Write "the RFC 9421 `created` parameter (§10.2.3)". (2) `IdentityChanged` row cites "(§2.1, §2.3)"; it is defined in §2.7: cite §2.7. (3) ARCHITECTURE "Pin and delete instructions": `PinInstruction` `op` is "pin" / "unpin" only (11:146); write "Pin and unpin instructions". Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
